mainEntity.name: Are there any specific considerations for painting older homes in Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting older homes in areas like Daly City often requires special attention due to their unique characteristics. Walls may have accumulated more layers of old paint, potentially hiding imperfections or requiring more extensive preparation, such as scraping or sanding. There might also be plaster walls instead of drywall, which demand specific techniques and materials. Our experienced team is adept at assessing and handling the particular challenges presented by older structures, ensuring proper surface preparation and a beautiful, lasting finish that respects the home's history.
